description: Active subscription, EPO OPS key MISSING, and the request is EP-only — so the only office the task needs is gated and the keyless tools (legal, academic, keyword analytics, PATSTAT analytics) are the only thing that still runs. They return real content, which is the trap: the doctrine allows offering them as DIFFERENT data but never as a substitute that closes the EP gap. The PATSTAT routes carry the sharpest version of the trap: harmonized family counts with a named applicant read like a patent answer, so their bodies return aggregates and an edition string and no publication number, title or claim text — anything document-shaped in the answer is the model's own (#182).
